name: Running Shoes
description: Hold B to walk faster, at a speed you pick: x1.5, x2, x3 or x4. Rides the engine's own movement.speed hook. Runs on every game the engine runs: Red, Blue, Yellow, Gold, Ruby, Sapphire, Emerald, FireRed and LeafGreen. A run can leave a tail of dust, flames or lightning, or a rainbow that comes out of the runner, passes under the sprite and is drawn back in when you stop. BURN GRASS cuts the tall grass you run across, the way CUT does, and SAFE GRASS carries you through it without a wild battle. TRAIL STATUS makes a wild Pokemon you meet at a run start the battle hit by your trail: flames burn, bolts paralyze, the rainbow confuses, and dust raises a sandstorm on Gen 3 or lowers accuracy on Gen 1 and 2. On Emerald, playing as the boy, SHOE MODEL and SHOE COLOUR put seven pairs in nine colours on your own feet. Every one of those has an off switch, the ones that change the game ship off, and with them left alone only the duration of a step changes. Optional boosts for the bicycle and for surfing too.
